description: RFC 0080 core builtin control, re-authored for RFC 0081 G3. The rent_roll omits available_room_nights, the field the hospitality class contract requires, so CLS-04 is an error. The calcs that read it degrade to null rather than throwing. CC-HOSP-03 still fires: hotel_brand is untouched, and one missing required field does not suppress findings about the sections that are present.
